newsitem.title: USA: Hub Group to buy out partners in Hub City.
newsitem.headline: Hub Group to buy out partners in Hub City.

text.p: Hub Group Inc said Wednesday it will acquire the limited partnership stake in Hub City North Central L.P. to become full owner of the company.
Hub Group already owns the general partnership interest in Hub City North Central, which provides trucking logistics services in the upper Midwest.
Hub Group will receive the stake in exchange for a note worth about $15 million, due January 1, 1998. The note carries an interest rate of seven percent, said Hub Group.
Hub Group offers freight logistics services through 34 offices, or Hubs, in the U.S., Canada and Mexico.
The company's stock was down 7/16 to 25-1/16.
